queries.sql: select "account_id", "enabled", "discovery_minutes", "time_zone", "next_catalogue_at", "next_discovery_at", "next_stories_at", "next_insights_at", "updated_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "failures", "retry_at", "claim_token", "claim_expires_at" from "collection_schedules" where ("collection_schedules"."enabled" = ? and "collection_schedules"."retry_at" <= ?) order by "collection_schedules"."retry_at", "collection_schedules"."next_discovery_at" limit ?

WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT *,CASE WHEN origin='activity' AND json_extract(cursor,'$[0].from')+7776000000<=?+900000 THEN 0 WHEN origin IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS urgency
      FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running' AND next_attempt_at<=? AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=?)
    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

WITH targets(hours,tolerance) AS (VALUES (?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?))
         SELECT m.id AS mediaId,t.hours AS targetHours,
           m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AS deadline
         FROM media m CROSS JOIN targets t
         WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.unavailable_until<=?
           AND m.published_at+t.hours*3600000<=?
           AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000>=?
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_snapshots s WHERE s.media_id=m.id
             AND s.observed_at BETWEEN m.published_at+(t.hours-t.tolerance)*3600000
               AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AND json_extract(s.metrics_json,'$.reach.value') IS NOT NULL)
         ORDER BY deadline,m.published_at,m.id,t.hours LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(m.published_at+86400000) AS expiry FROM media m
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type='STORY' AND m.published_at+86400000>?
        AND COALESCE((SELECT observed_at FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1),0)<m.published_at+86400000-900000

SELECT m.id FROM media m LEFT JOIN media_snapshots s ON s.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM media_snapshots latest WHERE latest.media_id=m.id ORDER BY latest.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1)
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.unavailable_until<=? AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.metrics_json) metric WHERE json_extract(metric.value,'$.reason')='request_deferred') OR COALESCE(s.observed_at,0) <= ? - CASE WHEN ?-m.published_at < 2*86400000 THEN 3600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 8*86400000 THEN 21600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 31*86400000 THEN 86400000 ELSE 604800000 END)
      ORDER BY COALESCE(s.observed_at,0),m.published_at DESC LIMIT 1
select "account_id", "expires_at", "refreshed_at", "scopes" from "instagram_connections"

SELECT m.id,m.published_at AS publishedAt FROM media m LEFT JOIN comment_media_state s ON s.media_id=m.id
       WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.published_at<=?
         AND COALESCE(s.unavailable_until,0)<=?
         AND (s.media_id IS NOT NULL OR m.published_at>?-720*3600000 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE account_id=m.account_id AND origin='comments' AND status='running'))
         AND (s.media_id IS NULL OR s.next_refresh_at<=? OR s.event_generation>s.processed_generation OR (s.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_comments_count IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'$.comments.value') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1)))
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE target_media_id=m.id AND origin='comments_refresh' AND status='running')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE target_media_id=m.id AND origin='comments_refresh' AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at>?)
       ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.event_generation>s.processed_generation THEN 0 WHEN s.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_comments_count IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'$.comments.value') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         CASE WHEN m.published_at>?-72*3600000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(s.next_refresh_at,0),m.published_at DESC,m.id LIMIT 1

ELSE NULL END, "last_attempt_at" = ?, "lease_token" = ?, "lease_expires_at" = ? where ("collection_jobs"."id" = ? and "collection_jobs"."status" = ? and "collection_jobs"."next_attempt_at" <= ? and ("collection_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL OR "collection_jobs"."lease_expires_at"<=?)) returning "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at"

INSERT INTO sync_leases (account_id,run_id,expires_at) VALUES (?,?,?)
      ON CONFLICT(account_id) DO UPDATE SET run_id=excluded.run_id,expires_at=excluded.expires_at
      WHERE sync_leases.expires_at <= ?
update "sync_runs" set "status" = ?, "completed_at" = ?, "error_code" = ? where ("sync_runs"."account_id" = ? and "sync_runs"."status" = ? and "sync_runs"."lease_expires_at" <= ?)

insert into "sync_runs" ("id", "account_id", "input_cursor", "page_size", "status", "started_at", "completed_at", "lease_expires_at", "next_cursor", "media_count", "useful_values", "coverage_state", "first_useful_at", "last_useful_at", "error_code", "kind", "target_media_id") values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, null, null, null, null, ?, ?, ?) on conflict ("sync_runs"."id") do update set "id" = ?, "account_id" = ?, "input_cursor" = ?, "page_size" = ?, "status" = ?, "started_at" = ?, "completed_at" = ?, "lease_expires_at" = ?, "next_cursor" = ?, "media_count" = ?, "error_code" = ?, "kind" = ?, "target_media_id" = ? where "sync_runs"."status" = ?

AND api_version=? AND expires_at>?) AS cachedUnavailableMetrics FROM instagram_api_state WHERE id=?
INSERT INTO instagram_http_attempts(id,account_id,operation_id,object_id,requested_at,received_at,payload_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,NULL,?)

INSERT INTO instagram_api_state(id,account_id,api_version,since_at,observed_at,attempts,accounting_since_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET attempts=instagram_api_state.attempts+1,accounting_since_at=COALESCE(instagram_api_state.accounting_since_at,excluded.accounting_since_at)
UPDATE instagram_http_attempts SET received_at=?,payload_json=? WHERE id=?

UPDATE instagram_api_state SET recorded_requests=recorded_requests+?,responses=responses+?,failures_before_response=failures_before_response+?,timeouts=timeouts+?,rate_limited_responses=rate_limited_responses+?,usage_headers_json=CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE usage_headers_json END,blocked_until=MAX(blocked_until,?),usage_percent=COALESCE(?,usage_percent),usage_observed_at=COALESCE(?,usage_observed_at),observed_at=CASE WHEN ? THEN MAX(COALESCE(observed_at,0),?) ELSE observed_at END WHERE id=?

      SELECT ?,?,?,?,?,? WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_leases l JOIN sync_runs r ON r.id=l.run_id WHERE l.account_id=? AND l.run_id=? AND l.expires_at>? AND r.started_at=? AND r.status='running') ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING

UPDATE accounts SET username=?,account_type=?,last_synced_at=? WHERE id=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_leases l JOIN sync_runs r ON r.id=l.run_id WHERE l.account_id=? AND l.run_id=? AND l.expires_at>? AND r.started_at=? AND r.status='running')

DELETE FROM sync_leases WHERE account_id=? AND run_id=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_runs WHERE id=? AND started_at=?)

SELECT 1 AS found FROM media_snapshots current WHERE current.operation_id=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_snapshots previous WHERE previous.media_id=current.media_id AND previous.id!=current.id AND previous.observed_at<=?) LIMIT 1

WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT *,CASE WHEN origin='activity' AND json_extract(cursor,'$[0].from')+7776000000<=?+900000 THEN 0 WHEN origin IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS urgency
      FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running' AND next_attempt_at<=? AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=?)
    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

queries.sql: UPDATE comment_collections SET result_json=?,observed_at=?,job_id=?,parent_id=?,page_fingerprint=? WHERE id=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.startedAt')=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)

INSERT INTO comment_media_state (media_id,last_attempt_at,last_complete_at,next_refresh_at,last_comments_count,processed_generation,omitted_branches,error_code,unavailable_until)
       SELECT ?,?,?,?,(SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'$.comments.value') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=? ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1),?,?,?,?
       WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)
       ON CONFLICT(media_id) DO UPDATE SET last_attempt_at=excluded.last_attempt_at,
         last_complete_at=COALESCE(excluded.last_complete_at,comment_media_state.last_complete_at),
         next_refresh_at=CASE WHEN excluded.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.next_refresh_at ELSE comment_media_state.next_refresh_at END,
         last_comments_count=CASE WHEN excluded.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.last_comments_count ELSE comment_media_state.last_comments_count END,
         processed_generation=MAX(comment_media_state.processed_generation,excluded.processed_generation),
         omitted_branches=excluded.omitted_branches,error_code=excluded.error_code,unavailable_until=excluded.unavailable_until

UPDATE collection_schedules SET last_success_at=MAX(COALESCE(last_success_at,0),?)
        WHERE account_id=? AND enabled=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)

UPDATE collection_jobs SET status=?,cursor=?,pages=?,collected=?,media_processed=?,skipped_media=?,skipped_periods=?,attempt=?,failures=?,next_attempt_at=?,completed_at=?,last_success_at=?,error_code=?,first_useful_observation_at=?,last_useful_observation_at=?,http_attempts=?,http_attempts_since_at=?,last_step_duration_ms=?,last_step_http_attempts=?,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?

select "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at" from "collection_jobs" where "collection_jobs"."id" = ? limit ?

select "account_id", "enabled", "discovery_minutes", "time_zone", "next_catalogue_at", "next_discovery_at", "next_stories_at", "next_insights_at", "updated_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "failures", "retry_at", "claim_token", "claim_expires_at" from "collection_schedules" where ("collection_schedules"."enabled" = ? and "collection_schedules"."retry_at" <= ?) order by "collection_schedules"."retry_at", "collection_schedules"."next_discovery_at" limit ?

WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT *,CASE WHEN origin='activity' AND json_extract(cursor,'$[0].from')+7776000000<=?+900000 THEN 0 WHEN origin IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS urgency
      FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running' AND next_attempt_at<=? AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=?)
    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

select "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at" from "collection_jobs" where "collection_jobs"."id" = ? limit ?

update "collection_jobs" set "first_attempt_at" = CASE WHEN "collection_jobs"."latency_origin"='recorded_from_creation' THEN COALESCE("collection_jobs"."first_attempt_at",?) ELSE NULL END, "last_attempt_at" = ?, "lease_token" = ?, "lease_expires_at" = ? where ("collection_jobs"."id" = ? and "collection_jobs"."status" = ? and "collection_jobs"."next_attempt_at" <= ? and ("collection_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL OR "collection_jobs"."lease_expires_at"<=?)) returning "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at"

SELECT id,published_at AS publishedAt FROM media WHERE account_id=? AND product_type!='STORY' AND published_at<=? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_media_state s WHERE s.media_id=media.id AND s.unavailable_until>?)  ORDER BY published_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT event_generation AS generation FROM comment_media_state WHERE media_id=?
select "id", "media_id", "signature", "observed_at", "result_json", "job_id", "parent_id", "page_fingerprint" from "comment_collections" where "comment_collections"."id" = ? limit ?

select "id", "account_id", "external_id", "caption", "title", "title_search", "search_text", "media_type", "product_type", "permalink", "published_at", "duration_seconds", "duration_source", "updated_at", "context_json", "metadata_json", "first_discovered_at", "discovery_source", "unavailable_until", "unavailable_code" from "media" where "media"."id" = ? limit ?
select "id", "media_id", "signature", "observed_at", "result_json", "job_id", "parent_id", "page_fingerprint" from "comment_collections" where "comment_collections"."id" = ? limit ?

insert into "comment_collections" ("id", "media_id", "signature", "observed_at", "result_json", "job_id", "parent_id", "page_fingerprint") values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, null) on conflict ("comment_collections"."id") do update set "observed_at" = ?, "result_json" = ? where json_extract("comment_collections"."result_json", '$.status')='failed' returning "id"
select "account_id", "encrypted_token", "expires_at", "refreshed_at", "scopes" from "instagram_connections" where "instagram_connections"."account_id" = ? limit ?
select "account_id", "encrypted_token", "expires_at", "refreshed_at", "scopes" from "instagram_connections" where "instagram_connections"."account_id" = ? limit ?

SELECT recorded_requests AS recordedRequests,since_at AS sinceAt,usage_percent AS usagePercent,usage_observed_at AS usageObservedAt,blocked_until AS blockedUntil,observed_at AS observedAt,attempts,responses,failures_before_response AS failuresBeforeResponse,timeouts,rate_limited_responses AS rateLimitedResponses,accounting_since_at AS accountingSinceAt,usage_headers_json AS usageHeadersJson,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instagram_metric_support WHERE account_id=? AND api_version=? AND expires_at>?) AS cachedUnavailableMetrics FROM instagram_api_state WHERE id=?
INSERT INTO instagram_http_attempts(id,account_id,operation_id,object_id,requested_at,received_at,payload_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,NULL,?)

INSERT INTO instagram_api_state(id,account_id,api_version,since_at,observed_at,attempts,accounting_since_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET attempts=instagram_api_state.attempts+1,accounting_since_at=COALESCE(instagram_api_state.accounting_since_at,excluded.accounting_since_at)
UPDATE instagram_http_attempts SET received_at=?,payload_json=? WHERE id=?

UPDATE instagram_api_state SET recorded_requests=recorded_requests+?,responses=responses+?,failures_before_response=failures_before_response+?,timeouts=timeouts+?,rate_limited_responses=rate_limited_responses+?,usage_headers_json=CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE usage_headers_json END,blocked_until=MAX(blocked_until,?),usage_percent=COALESCE(?,usage_percent),usage_observed_at=COALESCE(?,usage_observed_at),observed_at=CASE WHEN ? THEN MAX(COALESCE(observed_at,0),?) ELSE observed_at END WHERE id=?
DELETE FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at<? LIMIT 100)

UPDATE instagram_http_attempts SET payload_json=json_set(payload_json,'$.sample',NULL) WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at<? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.sample') IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100)
SELECT 1 FROM comment_collections WHERE media_id=? AND id!=? AND job_id=? AND parent_id IS ? AND page_fingerprint=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.status')='completed' LIMIT 1

WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_collections WHERE id=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.startedAt')=?) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET parent_id=COALESCE(excluded.parent_id,comments.parent_id),text=excluded.text,observed_at=excluded.observed_at,author_id=excluded.author_id,author_username=excluded.author_username,like_count=excluded.like_count,hidden=excluded.hidden WHERE comments.media_id=excluded.media_id AND comments.observed_at<=excluded.observed_at

queries.sql: UPDATE comment_collections SET result_json=?,observed_at=?,job_id=?,parent_id=?,page_fingerprint=? WHERE id=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.startedAt')=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)

INSERT INTO comment_media_state (media_id,last_attempt_at,last_complete_at,next_refresh_at,last_comments_count,processed_generation,omitted_branches,error_code,unavailable_until)
       SELECT ?,?,?,?,(SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'$.comments.value') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=? ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1),?,?,?,?
       WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)
       ON CONFLICT(media_id) DO UPDATE SET last_attempt_at=excluded.last_attempt_at,
         last_complete_at=COALESCE(excluded.last_complete_at,comment_media_state.last_complete_at),
         next_refresh_at=CASE WHEN excluded.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.next_refresh_at ELSE comment_media_state.next_refresh_at END,
         last_comments_count=CASE WHEN excluded.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.last_comments_count ELSE comment_media_state.last_comments_count END,
         processed_generation=MAX(comment_media_state.processed_generation,excluded.processed_generation),
         omitted_branches=excluded.omitted_branches,error_code=excluded.error_code,unavailable_until=excluded.unavailable_until

UPDATE collection_schedules SET last_success_at=MAX(COALESCE(last_success_at,0),?)
        WHERE account_id=? AND enabled=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)

UPDATE collection_jobs SET status=?,cursor=?,pages=?,collected=?,media_processed=?,skipped_media=?,skipped_periods=?,attempt=?,failures=?,next_attempt_at=?,completed_at=?,last_success_at=?,error_code=?,first_useful_observation_at=?,last_useful_observation_at=?,http_attempts=?,http_attempts_since_at=?,last_step_duration_ms=?,last_step_http_attempts=?,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?

select "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at" from "collection_jobs" where "collection_jobs"."id" = ? limit ?

select "account_id", "enabled", "discovery_minutes", "time_zone", "next_catalogue_at", "next_discovery_at", "next_stories_at", "next_insights_at", "updated_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "failures", "retry_at", "claim_token", "claim_expires_at" from "collection_schedules" where ("collection_schedules"."enabled" = ? and "collection_schedules"."retry_at" <= ?) order by "collection_schedules"."retry_at", "collection_schedules"."next_discovery_at" limit ?

WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT *,CASE WHEN origin='activity' AND json_extract(cursor,'$[0].from')+7776000000<=?+900000 THEN 0 WHEN origin IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS urgency
      FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running' AND next_attempt_at<=? AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=?)
    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

WITH targets(hours,tolerance) AS (VALUES (?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?))
         SELECT m.id AS mediaId,t.hours AS targetHours,
           m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AS deadline
         FROM media m CROSS JOIN targets t
         WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.unavailable_until<=?
           AND m.published_at+t.hours*3600000<=?
           AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000>=?
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_snapshots s WHERE s.media_id=m.id
             AND s.observed_at BETWEEN m.published_at+(t.hours-t.tolerance)*3600000
               AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AND json_extract(s.metrics_json,'$.reach.value') IS NOT NULL)
         ORDER BY deadline,m.published_at,m.id,t.hours LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(m.published_at+86400000) AS expiry FROM media m
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type='STORY' AND m.published_at+86400000>?
        AND COALESCE((SELECT observed_at FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1),0)<m.published_at+86400000-900000

       WHERE account_id=? AND observed_at>=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.status')='completed'
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload_json,'$.values') v WHERE json_extract(v.value,'$.reason')='request_deferred')
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.apiVersion')=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.kind')='activity'
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.timeZone')=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.metricType')='total_value'
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.breakdown') IS NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?) needed WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(account_insights.payload_json,'$.input.metrics') saved WHERE saved.value=needed.value))
       GROUP BY json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.from'),json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.to')

WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT *,CASE WHEN origin='activity' AND json_extract(cursor,'$[0].from')+7776000000<=?+900000 THEN 0 WHEN origin IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS urgency
      FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running' AND next_attempt_at<=? AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=?)
    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

WITH targets(hours,tolerance) AS (VALUES (?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?))
         SELECT m.id AS mediaId,t.hours AS targetHours,
           m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AS deadline
         FROM media m CROSS JOIN targets t
         WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.unavailable_until<=?
           AND m.published_at+t.hours*3600000<=?
           AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000>=?
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_snapshots s WHERE s.media_id=m.id
             AND s.observed_at BETWEEN m.published_at+(t.hours-t.tolerance)*3600000
               AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AND json_extract(s.metrics_json,'$.reach.value') IS NOT NULL)
         ORDER BY deadline,m.published_at,m.id,t.hours LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(m.published_at+86400000) AS expiry FROM media m
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type='STORY' AND m.published_at+86400000>?
        AND COALESCE((SELECT observed_at FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1),0)<m.published_at+86400000-900000

SELECT m.id FROM media m LEFT JOIN media_snapshots s ON s.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM media_snapshots latest WHERE latest.media_id=m.id ORDER BY latest.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1)
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.unavailable_until<=? AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.metrics_json) metric WHERE json_extract(metric.value,'$.reason')='request_deferred') OR COALESCE(s.observed_at,0) <= ? - CASE WHEN ?-m.published_at < 2*86400000 THEN 3600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 8*86400000 THEN 21600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 31*86400000 THEN 86400000 ELSE 604800000 END)
      ORDER BY COALESCE(s.observed_at,0),m.published_at DESC LIMIT 1

       WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.published_at<=?
         AND COALESCE(s.unavailable_until,0)<=?
         AND (s.media_id IS NOT NULL OR m.published_at>?-720*3600000 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE account_id=m.account_id AND origin='comments' AND status='running'))
         AND (s.media_id IS NULL OR s.next_refresh_at<=? OR s.event_generation>s.processed_generation OR (s.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_comments_count IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'$.comments.value') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1)))
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE target_media_id=m.id AND origin='comments_refresh' AND status='running')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE target_media_id=m.id AND origin='comments_refresh' AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at>?)
       ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.event_generation>s.processed_generation THEN 0 WHEN s.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_comments_count IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'$.comments.value') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,

WITH eligible AS (

    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

WITH targets(hours,tolerance) AS (VALUES (?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?))

           m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AS deadline
         FROM media m CROSS JOIN targets t
         WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.unavailable_until<=?
           AND m.published_at+t.hours*3600000<=?
           AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000>=?
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_snapshots s WHERE s.media_id=m.id
             AND s.observed_at BETWEEN m.published_at+(t.hours-t.tolerance)*3600000
               AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AND json_extract(s.metrics_json,'$.reach.value') IS NOT NULL)
         ORDER BY deadline,m.published_at,m.id,t.hours LIMIT 1

UPDATE collection_schedules SET last_success_at=MAX(COALESCE(last_success_at,0),?)
        WHERE account_id=? AND enabled=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)

UPDATE collection_jobs SET status=?,cursor=?,pages=?,collected=?,media_processed=?,skipped_media=?,skipped_periods=?,attempt=?,failures=?,next_attempt_at=?,completed_at=?,last_success_at=?,error_code=?,first_useful_observation_at=?,last_useful_observation_at=?,http_attempts=?,http_attempts_since_at=?,last_step_duration_ms=?,last_step_http_attempts=?,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?

select "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at" from "collection_jobs" where "collection_jobs"."id" = ? limit ?

select "account_id", "enabled", "discovery_minutes", "time_zone", "next_catalogue_at", "next_discovery_at", "next_stories_at", "next_insights_at", "updated_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "failures", "retry_at", "claim_token", "claim_expires_at" from "collection_schedules" where ("collection_schedules"."enabled" = ? and "collection_schedules"."retry_at" <= ?) order by "collection_schedules"."retry_at", "collection_schedules"."next_discovery_at" limit ?

WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT *,CASE WHEN origin='activity' AND json_extract(cursor,'$[0].from')+7776000000<=?+900000 THEN 0 WHEN origin IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS urgency
      FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running' AND next_attempt_at<=? AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=?)
    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

select "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at" from "collection_jobs" where "collection_jobs"."id" = ? limit ?

update "collection_jobs" set "first_attempt_at" = CASE WHEN "collection_jobs"."latency_origin"='recorded_from_creation' THEN COALESCE("collection_jobs"."first_attempt_at",?) ELSE NULL END, "last_attempt_at" = ?, "lease_token" = ?, "lease_expires_at" = ? where ("collection_jobs"."id" = ? and "collection_jobs"."status" = ? and "collection_jobs"."next_attempt_at" <= ? and ("collection_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL OR "collection_jobs"."lease_expires_at"<=?)) returning "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at"

SELECT id,published_at AS publishedAt FROM media WHERE account_id=? AND product_type!='STORY' AND published_at<=? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_media_state s WHERE s.media_id=media.id AND s.unavailable_until>?)  ORDER BY published_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT event_generation AS generation FROM comment_media_state WHERE media_id=?
select "id", "media_id", "signature", "observed_at", "result_json", "job_id", "parent_id", "page_fingerprint" from "comment_collections" where "comment_collections"."id" = ? limit ?

select "id", "account_id", "external_id", "caption", "title", "title_search", "search_text", "media_type", "product_type", "permalink", "published_at", "duration_seconds", "duration_source", "updated_at", "context_json", "metadata_json", "first_discovered_at", "discovery_source", "unavailable_until", "unavailable_code" from "media" where "media"."id" = ? limit ?
select "id", "media_id", "signature", "observed_at", "result_json", "job_id", "parent_id", "page_fingerprint" from "comment_collections" where "comment_collections"."id" = ? limit ?

insert into "comment_collections" ("id", "media_id", "signature", "observed_at", "result_json", "job_id", "parent_id", "page_fingerprint") values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, null) on conflict ("comment_collections"."id") do update set "observed_at" = ?, "result_json" = ? where json_extract("comment_collections"."result_json", '$.status')='failed' returning "id"
select "account_id", "encrypted_token", "expires_at", "refreshed_at", "scopes" from "instagram_connections" where "instagram_connections"."account_id" = ? limit ?
select "account_id", "encrypted_token", "expires_at", "refreshed_at", "scopes" from "instagram_connections" where "instagram_connections"."account_id" = ? limit ?

SELECT recorded_requests AS recordedRequests,since_at AS sinceAt,usage_percent AS usagePercent,usage_observed_at AS usageObservedAt,blocked_until AS blockedUntil,observed_at AS observedAt,attempts,responses,failures_before_response AS failuresBeforeResponse,timeouts,rate_limited_responses AS rateLimitedResponses,accounting_since_at AS accountingSinceAt,usage_headers_json AS usageHeadersJson,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instagram_metric_support WHERE account_id=? AND api_version=? AND expires_at>?) AS cachedUnavailableMetrics FROM instagram_api_state WHERE id=?
INSERT INTO instagram_http_attempts(id,account_id,operation_id,object_id,requested_at,received_at,payload_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,NULL,?)

INSERT INTO instagram_api_state(id,account_id,api_version,since_at,observed_at,attempts,accounting_since_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET attempts=instagram_api_state.attempts+1,accounting_since_at=COALESCE(instagram_api_state.accounting_since_at,excluded.accounting_since_at)
UPDATE instagram_http_attempts SET received_at=?,payload_json=? WHERE id=?

UPDATE instagram_api_state SET recorded_requests=recorded_requests+?,responses=responses+?,failures_before_response=failures_before_response+?,timeouts=timeouts+?,rate_limited_responses=rate_limited_responses+?,usage_headers_json=CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE usage_headers_json END,blocked_until=MAX(blocked_until,?),usage_percent=COALESCE(?,usage_percent),usage_observed_at=COALESCE(?,usage_observed_at),observed_at=CASE WHEN ? THEN MAX(COALESCE(observed_at,0),?) ELSE observed_at END WHERE id=?
DELETE FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at<? LIMIT 100)

UPDATE instagram_http_attempts SET payload_json=json_set(payload_json,'$.sample',NULL) WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at<? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.sample') IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100)
SELECT 1 FROM comment_collections WHERE media_id=? AND id!=? AND job_id=? AND parent_id IS ? AND page_fingerprint=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.status')='completed' LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO comments (id,media_id,parent_id,text,published_at,observed_at,author_id,author_username,like_count,hidden) SELECT json_extract(value,'$.id'),json_extract(value,'$.mediaId'),json_extract(value,'$.parentId'),json_extract(value,'$.text'),json_extract(value,'$.publishedAt'),json_extract(value,'$.observedAt'),json_extract(value,'$.authorId'),json_extract(value,'$.authorUsername'),json_extract(value,'$.likeCount'),json_extract(value,'$.hidden') FROM json_each(?) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_collections WHERE id=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.startedAt')=?) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET parent_id=COALESCE(excluded.parent_id,comments.parent_id),text=excluded.text,observed_at=excluded.observed_at,author_id=excluded.author_id,author_username=excluded.author_username,like_count=excluded.like_count,hidden=excluded.hidden WHERE comments.media_id=excluded.media_id AND comments.observed_at<=excluded.observed_at

INSERT INTO comment_media_state (media_id,last_attempt_at,last_complete_at,next_refresh_at,last_comments_count,processed_generation,omitted_branches,error_code,unavailable_until)
       SELECT ?,?,?,?,(SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'$.comments.value') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=? ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1),?,?,?,?
       WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)
       ON CONFLICT(media_id) DO UPDATE SET last_attempt_at=excluded.last_attempt_at,
         last_complete_at=COALESCE(excluded.last_complete_at,comment_media_state.last_complete_at),
         next_refresh_at=CASE WHEN excluded.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.next_refresh_at ELSE comment_media_state.next_refresh_at END,
         last_comments_count=CASE WHEN excluded.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.last_comments_count ELSE comment_media_state.last_comments_count END,
         processed_generation=MAX(comment_media_state.processed_generation,excluded.processed_generation),
         omitted_branches=excluded.omitted_branches,error_code=excluded.error_code,unavailable_until=excluded.unavailable_until

WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT *,CASE WHEN origin='activity' AND json_extract(cursor,'$[0].from')+7776000000<=?+900000 THEN 0 WHEN origin IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS urgency
      FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running' AND next_attempt_at<=? AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=?)
    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

select "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at" from "collection_jobs" where "collection_jobs"."id" = ? limit ?

update "collection_jobs" set "first_attempt_at" = CASE WHEN "collection_jobs"."latency_origin"='recorded_from_creation' THEN COALESCE("collection_jobs"."first_attempt_at",?) ELSE NULL END, "last_attempt_at" = ?, "lease_token" = ?, "lease_expires_at" = ? where ("collection_jobs"."id" = ? and "collection_jobs"."status" = ? and "collection_jobs"."next_attempt_at" <= ? and ("collection_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL OR "collection_jobs"."lease_expires_at"<=?)) returning "id", "account_id", "origin", "target_media_id", "automatic", "status", "cursor", "pages", "collected", "media_processed", "skipped_media", "skipped_periods", "attempt", "failures", "next_attempt_at", "started_at", "completed_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "latency_origin", "http_attempts_since_at", "first_attempt_at", "last_attempt_at", "first_useful_observation_at", "last_useful_observation_at", "http_attempts", "last_step_duration_ms", "last_step_http_attempts", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at"

SELECT id,published_at AS publishedAt FROM media WHERE account_id=? AND product_type!='STORY' AND published_at<=? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_media_state s WHERE s.media_id=media.id AND s.unavailable_until>?)  ORDER BY published_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT event_generation AS generation FROM comment_media_state WHERE media_id=?
select "id", "media_id", "signature", "observed_at", "result_json", "job_id", "parent_id", "page_fingerprint" from "comment_collections" where "comment_collections"."id" = ? limit ?

select "id", "account_id", "external_id", "caption", "title", "title_search", "search_text", "media_type", "product_type", "permalink", "published_at", "duration_seconds", "duration_source", "updated_at", "context_json", "metadata_json", "first_discovered_at", "discovery_source", "unavailable_until", "unavailable_code" from "media" where "media"."id" = ? limit ?
select "id", "media_id", "signature", "observed_at", "result_json", "job_id", "parent_id", "page_fingerprint" from "comment_collections" where "comment_collections"."id" = ? limit ?

AND api_version=? AND expires_at>?) AS cachedUnavailableMetrics FROM instagram_api_state WHERE id=?
INSERT INTO instagram_http_attempts(id,account_id,operation_id,object_id,requested_at,received_at,payload_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,NULL,?)

INSERT INTO instagram_api_state(id,account_id,api_version,since_at,observed_at,attempts,accounting_since_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET attempts=instagram_api_state.attempts+1,accounting_since_at=COALESCE(instagram_api_state.accounting_since_at,excluded.accounting_since_at)
UPDATE instagram_http_attempts SET received_at=?,payload_json=? WHERE id=?

UPDATE instagram_api_state SET recorded_requests=recorded_requests+?,responses=responses+?,failures_before_response=failures_before_response+?,timeouts=timeouts+?,rate_limited_responses=rate_limited_responses+?,usage_headers_json=CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE usage_headers_json END,blocked_until=MAX(blocked_until,?),usage_percent=COALESCE(?,usage_percent),usage_observed_at=COALESCE(?,usage_observed_at),observed_at=CASE WHEN ? THEN MAX(COALESCE(observed_at,0),?) ELSE observed_at END WHERE id=?
DELETE FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at<? LIMIT 100)

UPDATE instagram_http_attempts SET payload_json=json_set(payload_json,'$.sample',NULL) WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at<? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.sample') IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100)
SELECT 1 FROM comment_collections WHERE media_id=? AND id!=? AND job_id=? AND parent_id IS ? AND page_fingerprint=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.status')='completed' LIMIT 1

WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_collections WHERE id=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.startedAt')=?) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?) queries.sql: UPDATE comment_collections SET result_json=?,observed_at=?,job_id=?,parent_id=?,page_fingerprint=? WHERE id=? AND json_extract(result_json,'$.startedAt')=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)

INSERT INTO comment_media_state (media_id,last_attempt_at,last_complete_at,next_refresh_at,last_comments_count,processed_generation,omitted_branches,error_code,unavailable_until)
       SELECT ?,?,?,?,(SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'$.comments.value') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=? ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1),?,?,?,?
       WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)
       ON CONFLICT(media_id) DO UPDATE SET last_attempt_at=excluded.last_attempt_at,
         last_complete_at=COALESCE(excluded.last_complete_at,comment_media_state.last_complete_at),
         next_refresh_at=CASE WHEN excluded.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.next_refresh_at ELSE comment_media_state.next_refresh_at END,
         last_comments_count=CASE WHEN excluded.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.last_comments_count ELSE comment_media_state.last_comments_count END,
         processed_generation=MAX(comment_media_state.processed_generation,excluded.processed_generation),
         omitted_branches=excluded.omitted_branches,error_code=excluded.error_code,unavailable_until=excluded.unavailable_until

UPDATE collection_schedules SET last_success_at=MAX(COALESCE(last_success_at,0),?)
        WHERE account_id=? AND enabled=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?)

UPDATE collection_jobs SET status=?,cursor=?,pages=?,collected=?,media_processed=?,skipped_media=?,skipped_periods=?,attempt=?,failures=?,next_attempt_at=?,completed_at=?,last_success_at=?,error_code=?,first_useful_observation_at=?,last_useful_observation_at=?,http_attempts=?,http_attempts_since_at=?,last_step_duration_ms=?,last_step_http_attempts=?,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_token=? AND lease_expires_at>?

select "account_id", "enabled", "discovery_minutes", "time_zone", "next_catalogue_at", "next_discovery_at", "next_stories_at", "next_insights_at", "updated_at", "last_success_at", "error_code", "failures", "retry_at", "claim_token", "claim_expires_at" from "collection_schedules" where ("collection_schedules"."enabled" = ? and "collection_schedules"."retry_at" <= ?) order by "collection_schedules"."retry_at", "collection_schedules"."next_discovery_at" limit ?

WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT *,CASE WHEN origin='activity' AND json_extract(cursor,'$[0].from')+7776000000<=?+900000 THEN 0 WHEN origin IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS urgency
      FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running' AND next_attempt_at<=? AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=?)
    ) SELECT
      (SELECT id FROM eligible ORDER BY urgency,next_attempt_at,started_at,id LIMIT 1) jobId,
      (SELECT id FROM eligible WHERE origin NOT IN ('stories','scheduled','comments_refresh') ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgency=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(last_attempt_at,0),started_at,id LIMIT 1) archiveId

WITH targets(hours,tolerance) AS (VALUES (?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?))
         SELECT m.id AS mediaId,t.hours AS targetHours,
           m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AS deadline
         FROM media m CROSS JOIN targets t
         WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.unavailable_until<=?
           AND m.published_at+t.hours*3600000<=?
           AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000>=?
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_snapshots s WHERE s.media_id=m.id
             AND s.observed_at BETWEEN m.published_at+(t.hours-t.tolerance)*3600000
               AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AND json_extract(s.metrics_json,'$.reach.value') IS NOT NULL)
         ORDER BY deadline,m.published_at,m.id,t.hours LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(m.published_at+86400000) AS expiry FROM media m
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type='STORY' AND m.published_at+86400000>?
        AND COALESCE((SELECT observed_at FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1),0)<m.published_at+86400000-900000

SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.from') AS "from",json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.to') AS "to",MAX(observed_at) AS observedAt FROM account_insights
       WHERE account_id=? AND observed_at>=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.status')='completed'
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload_json,'$.values') v WHERE json_extract(v.value,'$.reason')='request_deferred')
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.apiVersion')=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.kind')='activity'
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.timeZone')=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.metricType')='total_value'
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.breakdown') IS NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?) needed WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(account_insights.payload_json,'$.input.metrics') saved WHERE saved.value=needed.value))
       GROUP BY json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.from'),json_extract(payload_json,'$.input.to')

         SELECT m.id AS mediaId,t.hours AS targetHours,
           m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AS deadline
         FROM media m CROSS JOIN targets t
         WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='STORY' AND m.unavailable_until<=?
           AND m.published_at+t.hours*3600000<=?
